extracted.name: BBQ Pulled Pork Pizza
extracted.description: This easy appetizer pizza is a great way to use the leftovers from your slow cooker pulled pork. You can add any extra toppings to customize.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons barbeque sauce, or more as desired
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Place pizza crust on a baking sheet.
Combine barbecue sauce and chipotle chili powder in a bowl; season with salt and black pepper. Spread over crust.
Arrange pork, onion, and bell pepper on top sauce.
Bake in the preheated oven until toppings hot and crust crisp on bottom, 12 to 15 minutes.
